ValidationRule.description: Prevents Syndicate/Investor from being selected as either Buyer or Seller when the offer is Fund-to-Fund.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Offer_Initiated_By__c) = "Funds / Funds", OR( TEXT(Buyer__c) = "Syndicate/Investor", TEXT(Seller__c) = "Syndicate/Investor" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Funds / Funds trades, neither Buyer nor Seller can be Syndicate/Investor.
